The '''Ramunee family''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] family of [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. The family consisted of the parents and eight children, two of which, [[Veni Ramunee|Veni]] and [[Vici Ramunee|Vici]] were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. The family lived near [[Lir Lake]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and distilled the [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] [[l'lahsh]].
